applies_why: The judge breaks a challenger link using Matthew 1:18, 1:25 and Luke 1:34, which is exactly the verse-against-a-link action the rule governs.
quote: Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost" and Matthew 1:25 "knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son" contradict C3's claim of espousal union
rule_words: A verse counts against a link only if an earlier round pressed it against that link. The judge must quote that round's sentence and name the round.
room: 'The judge must quote that round's sentence and name the round': read as requiring round-naming and quotation for any breaking verse, versus a looser reading that scripture citations alone suffice; the strict reading is the rule's plain command.
why: The judge breaks the link with three verses but names no round and quotes no pressing sentence from any earlier round, leaving undone what the rule requires.
